ruleset.name: Klever Java Rules
ruleset.description:
Java standards for Klever services. Consumed by the PMD quality gate hook (~/.claude/hooks/pmd-java-gate.py) and reusable by maven-pmd-plugin in CI.
Thresholds are deliberately tighter than PMD defaults. PMD ships cyclomatic at 10 and cognitive at 15. At those levels this codebase reported 2 and 0 violations respectively, which is silence, not health.
Rules marked ADVISORY in the hook config report but do not block.

rule.name: NoRawObjectReturn
rule.message: Method returns raw Object. Declare the type the caller actually needs.
rule.description: A raw Object return pushes the cast to every caller and erases the contract. A ClassType that is a direct child of MethodDeclaration is the return type. Parameter types sit deeper, under FormalParameters, so they do not match.

rule.name: NoNullReturn
rule.message: Returns null. Use Optional for absence, or throw for failure.
rule.description:
A null return makes absence invisible in the signature. The caller learns about it from a NullPointerException at runtime, or from a comment that goes stale. Optional puts it in the type.
This also catches the null-means-success idiom, where a method returns a refusal reason and null signals approval. Prefer an explicit result type carrying both the verdict and the reason.

rule.name: NoUncheckedThrow
rule.message: Unchecked exception thrown. Consider a checked exception, or document why unchecked is right.
rule.description:
ADVISORY by default, and deliberately so.
Requested as "every throw should be checked". Recorded here, but shipped advisory because the blanket form conflicts with the framework this service runs on. Spring's entire DataAccessException hierarchy is unchecked on purpose: checked exceptions at scale produced empty catch blocks. A @RestController method also cannot propagate a checked exception cleanly.
IllegalStateException for "this state should be impossible" is idiomatic, not sloppy. The real objections behind the request are swallowed exceptions and lost stack traces, which EmptyCatchBlock and PreserveStackTrace below catch directly and block on.
Flip to blocking in the hook config if you disagree after seeing real hits.
